message.content:
An editorial illustration features a pale green background framed by a solid red vertical stripe on the left and a red horizontal stripe at the bottom. The large red word "TEMPO" dominates the top. Below, a man with short black hair, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and blue pants, sits in a black driver's seat. He holds a black steering wheel, looking forward with a slight smile.

The seat and steering column are part of a deconstructed, dark grey mechanical structure. Exposed wires, gears, and metallic components are visible. This structure is surrounded by broken pieces of an orange bus exterior. A large black tire sits horizontally beneath the wreckage. Fragments of orange paneling, including one with a silver rectangular light, lie scattered on the ground.

At the bottom left, large black text reads "AWAS JOKOWI". Below it, smaller black and red text states: "Bekas anggota tim sukses Gubernur ditengarai terlibat pengadaan bus berkarat Transjakarta." Other text at the top includes "Seleksi Amburadul Hakim Konstitusi" and "Ada Klorin di Beras Vietnam." A barcode and price are in the bottom right.
